**Continuous 2.4.3**, a community-maintained fork of the Continue VS Code extension. Continuous is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by Continue Dev, Inc.

It installs alongside the original extension (its ID is `b1tninja.continuous`), brings your existing `~/.continue` configuration with it, and collects no telemetry. To update from 2.4.2, install the new `.vsix` the same way. Coming from 2.4.1 or earlier, also see [Continued is now Continuous](https://github.com/b1tninja/continuous/releases/tag/v2.4.2-vscode) in the 2.4.2 notes: the extension ID changed.

## Install

1. Download the `.vsix` for your platform below and, optionally, check it against `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
2. Run `code --install-extension continuous-<platform>-2.4.3.vsix --force`, or in VS Code use the Extensions view: `...` → **Install from VSIX…**, then reload the window.

Requires VS Code 1.105 or newer. The packages are not code-signed. Full instructions: [install guide](https://github.com/b1tninja/continuous/blob/main/docs/continuous-install.md).

| Platform                    | File                                                                     |
| --------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Windows x64 / Arm64         | `continuous-win32-x64-2.4.3.vsix`, `continuous-win32-arm64-2.4.3.vsix`   |
| macOS Apple Silicon / Intel | `continuous-darwin-arm64-2.4.3.vsix`, `continuous-darwin-x64-2.4.3.vsix` |
| Linux x64 / Arm64           | `continuous-linux-x64-2.4.3.vsix`, `continuous-linux-arm64-2.4.3.vsix`   |

Each platform also has an **agents** build, `continuous-<platform>-2.4.3-agents.vsix`. It adds Continuous to VS Code's Agents window through APIs that are still proposed, so it works in VS Code Insiders, or in Stable started with `code --enable-proposed-api b1tninja.continuous`. Without that it works like the normal build. See [VS Code Chat and Agents](https://b1tninja.github.io/continuous/customize/vscode-chat-and-agents).

## The CLI, as a release file

The release now carries the fork's terminal agent too, as `continuous-cli-2.4.3.tgz`. Install it on Node 22 or newer:

```sh
npm i -g https://github.com/b1tninja/continuous/releases/download/v2.4.3-vscode/continuous-cli-2.4.3.tgz
```

The package is `@b1tninja/continuous-cli` and the command is `continuous`, so it installs alongside upstream's `cn`. It reads the same `~/.continuous` configuration as the extension and has no dependencies to fetch. It is not published to npm.

## What's new since 2.4.2

- **Reorder queued messages in the IDE.** Each queued message has move up and move down buttons, and a row can be dragged onto another. Queued messages are merged and sent in that order.
- **Select a queued message in the CLI.** With the prompt empty, ↓ highlights the first queued message. ↑ and ↓ move the highlight, `+` and `-` move the message, Delete removes it, Enter takes just that message back into the prompt, and Esc returns to the prompt without stopping the agent. Order matters here, since `/` and `!` commands run one at a time in queue order.
- **The CLI never drops queued messages unasked.** Rewinding in the edit picker and a config reload now keep the queue, paused, instead of clearing it. Ctrl+C on messages taken back with ↑ puts them back at the front of the queue. Only removing a message deletes it.
- **← and → switch the CLI's mode on an empty prompt**, back and forward through normal, plan and auto. With text in the prompt they move the cursor as before; Shift+Tab is unchanged.

## Not included

The JetBrains plugin and the hosted Continue Hub are not part of Continuous. Hub `uses: owner/name` blocks are not supported; configure models and blocks directly or with local file paths.
